title: Spacing practice in a toy study (sample)
description: A made-up paper for testing the app. It compares cramming with spaced practice in an invented class.

discover_cards.title: The question
discover_cards.front: Does spreading the same practice over days help more than doing it all at once?

discover_cards.title: How it was tested
discover_cards.front: Two invented groups practised the same 40 words: one in one session, one in four short sessions.
discover_cards.back: Everyone took the same test a week later.

discover_cards.title: What they found
discover_cards.front: The spaced group remembered about twice as many words a week later.
discover_cards.back: Both groups did equally well on a test right after practice.

discover_cards.title: Why spacing works
discover_cards.front: A little forgetting between sessions makes each review work harder, and harder work lasts longer.

discover_cards.title: Limits of the study
discover_cards.front: The toy study had one class and one kind of material, so the result may not hold everywhere.

discover_cards.title: Cramming works best
discover_cards.front: Cramming the night before is the best way to remember.
discover_cards.back: Cramming helps the next day's test but fades fast; spacing lasts longer.

discover_cards.title: How big is the effect?
discover_cards.front: An effect size says how big a difference is, not only whether it exists.

practice_cards.prompt: A week later, which group remembered more words?
What changed between the two groups right after practice?
practice_cards.answer: Nothing: they only differed a week later.
